title: Google Ads API v22 sunset on 2026-10-07
summary: Google Ads API v22 was sunset on 2026-10-07; from that date all v22 requests fail. Code still pinned to /v22/ paths, or to client library versions that only speak v22, is broken.
migrationNote: Change the version segment of googleads.googleapis.com paths to a supported version (v24 or later is safest, since v23 sunsets in February 2027), upgrade the client library, and work through each skipped version's breaking-changes list. The Google Ads API metrics page in the Cloud Console shows which versioned methods your project still calls.

provenance.quote: Google Ads API v22 will sunset on October 7, 2026. Starting on this date, all v22 API requests will begin to fail.
